Core Commercial Commitments

We support merchant growth on the network with these core standards:

  • Fair Commissions: No hidden store fees. Standard commission percentages are detailed directly in your sign-up sheets.
  • Preparation Efficiency: Automatic rider dispatch algorithms ensure prepared orders are collected as soon as they are ready.
  • Secure Settlements: Direct deposit settlements are completed automatically on a bi-weekly cycle.
